description: Backend connector, registry entry, stage catalog, stage handler, CDK infrastructure, and backend tests. This is the main integration layer that wires the Field Discovery Agent into the Field-to-Fix pipeline. Depends on FEAT-001 (seed data and Lambda handlers must exist). FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 (frontend) are independent of each other once FEAT-001 is done.
steps: Create backend/app/connectors/field_discovery.py following the ota.py pattern exactly. Three classes: (1) BedrockAgentFieldDiscovery — sets info.status='connected', self.simulated=False; discover() calls boto3 bedrock-agent-runtime invoke_agent with agentId from os.environ['BEDROCK_AGENT_ID'] and agentAliasId from os.environ.get('BEDROCK_AGENT_ALIAS_ID','live'), sessionId=f'f2f-{oem}-{int(time.time())}', inputText=json.dumps({oem,models,since_days}); accumulates streaming completion chunks from response['completion'] event stream; parses JSON from accumulated text. (2) LambdaFieldDiscovery — sets info.status='connected', self.simulated=False; discover() calls boto3 lambda_ client invoke(FunctionName=os.environ['FIELD_DISCOVERY_LAMBDA_ARN'], Payload=json.dumps({oem,models,since_days})); parses response Payload. (3) SimulatedFieldDiscovery — sets info.status='simulated', self.simulated=True; discover() reads ROOT/'data'/'stellantis_seed_issues.json', filters by oem/models if provided, returns {issues: list, sources: [{name: 'seed-data', category: 'simulated', simulated: True, count: N}], simulated: True}. Factory function field_discovery_connector() checks settings.mode=='aws' and os.environ.get('BEDROCK_AGENT_ID') for class 1, os.environ.get('FIELD_DISCOVERY_LAMBDA_ARN') for class 2, else class 3. Import: from ..config import ROOT, settings; import os, json, time.

Add import and entry to backend/app/connectors/registry.py: add 'from .field_discovery import field_discovery_connector' at the top with other connector imports. Add (field_discovery_connector().info, ['field_discovery']) as the FIRST entry in the entries list (before reddit).

Prepend FIELD_DISCOVERY stage to STAGES list in backend/app/stages.py as index 0: StageDef(key='field_discovery', name='Field Discovery', v_level='Field operation', v_side='field', agent='Field Discovery Agent (Bedrock)', capability='signal_source', description='Crawls NHTSA, forums, Reddit, app stores and social media to surface actionable Stellantis/Uconnect software issues.').

Add field_discovery stage handler to backend/app/agents/stages.py. Add import at top: 'from ..connectors.field_discovery import field_discovery_connector'. Add field_discovery(ctx: StageContext) function BEFORE the detect() function. The function: (a) instantiates connector, sets ctx.run.connector=conn.info.name, ctx.run.simulated=conn.simulated; (b) reads oem from ctx.shared.get('oem','Stellantis'), models from ctx.shared.get('models',['Dodge','Jeep','RAM','Chrysler','Uconnect']), since_days from ctx.shared.get('since_days',90); (c) calls ctx.thought() describing the search scope; (d) calls result=conn.discover(oem,models,since_days); (e) logs per-source live/simulated status using ctx.log(); (f) stores result artifacts with ctx.artifact() for 'Discovered issues' (json) and 'Source coverage' (json); (g) stores ctx.shared['discovered_issues']=issues for downstream stages; (h) calls ctx.set() with summary string and outputs dict including total_issues, actionable count, sources_live, sources_simulated, engine string.

Add CDK constructs to infra/app.py: (a) Add 'aws_cdk.aws_bedrock as bedrock' to the import block (alphabetically after aws_apprunner, before aws_cognito or at end of aws_ imports). (b) At class level after the existing 'table' DynamoDB definition, add FieldIssuesTable: ddb.Table(self,'FieldIssues', partition_key=ddb.Attribute(name='pk',type=ddb.AttributeType.STRING), sort_key=ddb.Attribute(name='sk',type=ddb.AttributeType.STRING), billing_mode=ddb.BillingMode.PAY_PER_REQUEST, removal_policy=RemovalPolicy.DESTROY). (c) Add seed file copy at top of __init__ (after super().__init__ call): import shutil at module top; _seed_src=ROOT/'data'/'stellantis_seed_issues.json'; _seed_dst=ROOT/'infra'/'lambda_'/'field_discovery'/'data'/'stellantis_seed_issues.json'; _seed_dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); shutil.copy2(_seed_src,_seed_dst) if _seed_src.exists() else None. (d) Two lambda_.Function constructs: search_fn = lambda_.Function(self,'FieldDiscoverySearch', code=lambda_.Code.from_asset(str(ROOT/'infra'/'lambda_'/'field_discovery')), runtime=lambda_.Runtime.PYTHON_3_12, handler='handler.lambda_handler', timeout=Duration.minutes(5), memory_size=512, environment={'FIELD_ISSUES_TABLE':field_issues_table.table_name,'SEED_DATA_PATH':'/var/task/data/stellantis_seed_issues.json','AWS_REGION_NAME':self.region}); ingest_fn = lambda_.Function(self,'FieldDiscoveryIngest', same pattern with handler='ingest.lambda_handler'). field_issues_table.grant_read_write_data(search_fn); field_issues_table.grant_read_write_data(ingest_fn). Add bedrock IAM policy to both. (e) agent_role = iam.Role(self,'FieldDiscoveryAgentRole', assumed_by=iam.ServicePrincipal('bedrock.amazonaws.com')); add iam.PolicyStatement(actions=['bedrock:InvokeModel'],resources=['*']) and iam.PolicyStatement(actions=['lambda:InvokeFunction'],resources=[search_fn.function_arn,ingest_fn.function_arn]). (f) search_fn.add_permission and ingest_fn.add_permission for bedrock.amazonaws.com principal. (g) field_discovery_agent = bedrock.CfnAgent(self,'FieldDiscoveryAgent', agent_name='field-discovery-agent', foundation_model='anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0', agent_resource_role_arn=agent_role.role_arn, instruction='You are a field intelligence analyst for automotive OEMs. Given an OEM name and vehicle model list, systematically search all configured complaint and feedback sources for software-related issues. Call search_all_sources to crawl all sources in parallel, then call ingest_issues to store and deduplicate the results. Return a structured JSON report containing: total_issues, deduplicated_count, actionable_issues (list of issues with is_actionable_in_mvp=true), source_coverage (per-source live/simulated status), top_priority_issues (top 5 by frequency_score descending).', action_groups=[bedrock.CfnAgent.AgentActionGroupProperty(action_group_name='web-search-action', action_group_executor=bedrock.CfnAgent.ActionGroupExecutorProperty(lambda_=search_fn.function_arn), action_group_state='ENABLED', function_schema=bedrock.CfnAgent.FunctionSchemaProperty(functions=[bedrock.CfnAgent.FunctionProperty(name='search_all_sources',description='Search all configured sources for OEM issues',parameters={'oem':bedrock.CfnAgent.ParameterDetailProperty(type='string',description='OEM name e.g. Stellantis',required=True),'models':bedrock.CfnAgent.ParameterDetailProperty(type='string',description='Comma-separated vehicle model names',required=True),'since_days':bedrock.CfnAgent.ParameterDetailProperty(type='integer',description='Look back window in days',required=False)}),bedrock.CfnAgent.FunctionProperty(name='search_source',description='Search one specific source',parameters={'source_name':bedrock.CfnAgent.ParameterDetailProperty(type='string',description='Source name from DISCOVERY_SOURCES',required=True),'query':bedrock.CfnAgent.ParameterDetailProperty(type='string',description='Search query string',required=True),'since_days':bedrock.CfnAgent.ParameterDetailProperty(type='integer',description='Look back window in days',required=False)})])), bedrock.CfnAgent.AgentActionGroupProperty(action_group_name='issue-ingest-action', action_group_executor=bedrock.CfnAgent.ActionGroupExecutorProperty(lambda_=ingest_fn.function_arn), action_group_state='ENABLED', function_schema=bedrock.CfnAgent.FunctionSchemaProperty(functions=[bedrock.CfnAgent.FunctionProperty(name='ingest_issues',description='Store and deduplicate discovered issues into DynamoDB',parameters={'oem':bedrock.CfnAgent.ParameterDetailProperty(type='string',description='OEM name',required=True),'issues_json':bedrock.CfnAgent.ParameterDetailProperty(type='string',description='JSON array string of issue objects',required=True)})]))], auto_prepare=True). (h) field_discovery_alias = bedrock.CfnAgentAlias(self,'FieldDiscoveryLive', agent_id=field_discovery_agent.ref, agent_alias_name='live'). (i) CfnOutput for FieldDiscoveryAgentId and FieldDiscoveryAliasArn.

Create backend/tests/test_field_discovery.py with all 6 tests described in plan item 10. Set env vars before imports: os.environ['F2F_LLM']='offline', os.environ['F2F_STATE_DIR']=tempfile.mkdtemp(), os.environ['F2F_KEYS_DIR']=..., os.environ['F2F_DEMO_PACE']='0.0'. Tests: test_simulated_connector_returns_issues, test_simulated_flag_is_true, test_discover_response_shape, test_deduplication_merges_similar_titles (imports from infra.lambda_.field_discovery.ingest), test_deduplication_keeps_distinct_titles, test_discovery_sources_cover_required_categories (imports from infra.lambda_.field_discovery.handler). Also add infra/__init__.py and infra/lambda_/__init__.py if they do not exist, so the import path works.
acceptance_criteria: backend/app/connectors/field_discovery.py exists with SimulatedFieldDiscovery, BedrockAgentFieldDiscovery, LambdaFieldDiscovery classes and field_discovery_connector() factory

findings: All 5 verification checks pass. (1) connector: SimulatedFieldDiscovery reads seed JSON, filters by models, returns {issues, sources, simulated}. (2) registry: field_discovery_connector() entry is first in the catalog() list. (3) stages: FIELD_DISCOVERY is at index 0 of STAGES. (4) CDK: aws_bedrock imported as 'bedrock'; pre-existing local variable 'bedrock = iam.PolicyStatement(...)' renamed to 'bedrock_policy' to avoid shadowing; FieldIssues DynamoDB table, search/ingest Lambdas, IAM role, CfnAgent + CfnAgentAlias and CfnOutputs all added; synth produces 41 resources. (5) Tests: all 6 tests in test_field_discovery.py pass; e2e test passes with the new handler. FEAT-003 note: the connector's info.status is 'simulated' in offline mode — UI badge should show amber 'simulated' label per design rules.
